content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NMDFC Senior Legal Consultant Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 08-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NMDFC Senior Legal Consultant position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 08-09-2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Legal Consultant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in a relevant field or subject, or equivalent technical qualifications like an MBA. A minimum of 10 years of post-qualification experience is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. Are retired government employees eligible for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, retired Government Employees with a Grade Pay of Rs. 5400/Level-10 (7th Pay Commission) and above, possessing 10 years of relevant experience, are also eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is ordinarily 65 years as of the closing date for the receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Legal Consultant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs 90,000/- per month, which is all-inclusive.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the NMDFC Senior Legal Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email only. You need to send your duly filled application form along with self-attested copies of relevant documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Senior Legal Consultant.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The position is on a contract basis, with the contract being extendable.

faq.question: Q9. What are the key responsibilities of a Senior Legal Consultant?
faq.answer: The role involves providing legal advisory services, handling litigation, and managing contractual matters for the organization.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes the scrutiny of applications, shortlisting of eligible candidates, and a personal interaction or interview conducted by a Selection Committee.
